_what: Hand-written labels for the eval. Only the rows where the arms disagreed with each other, or where the rule floor disagreed with them, are listed. A full gold standard is not the goal; these are the rows where a label changes a number that matters.
_who: Joel writes these. The script does not, and will not: a label written by the thing being graded proves nothing. Every category and priority below ships null and stays null until a person fills it in. A null row is counted as unlabelled, never as agreement.
_how: Set category to one of: prospect, existing_client, fraud_risk, compliance, unknown, junk. Set priority to one of: high, medium, low. "why" is for you and the live session, not for the script.
_deliberately_absent: What the arms answered is deliberately NOT in this file - it is in the report. Reading the candidates before writing the label is the same anchoring effect this eval exists to measure, applied to the labeller.
_rerun: This file is read and never rewritten. Delete it to get a fresh stub.
